newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market ends firmer in high-cap buying.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market ends firmer in high-cap buying.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market closed stronger on Wednesday in buying pressure on high-cap stocks from foreign investors, traders said.
They said the metallurgical, oil and cement sectors had been the main targets of portfolio investors.
"We see the rally for heavyweights continuing for the rest of the month," one said.
On Wednesday, advancers outnumbered losers by 103 to 66, while prices of 258 stocks remained unchanged.

Three independent indices, computed by brokerage houses on the basis of average prices and market capitalisation, climbed from the previous session. VAB-RA grew by 3.61 percent to 4,301.1 points, BIG-OTC rose by 3.74 percent to 3,315.97 and CAS-RQ was up 3.61 percent at 760 points.
Sidex -- which has around 15 percent of market capitalisation -- gained 500 lei at close to 18,000.
Traders said Sidex was poised to break through the level of 20,000 in the next days on the back of its sound economic performance.
Oil refinerie Petromidia was among gainers, ending 4,000 lei firmer at 33,500.
Cement maker Romcim was volatile in thin supply but gained 3,000 lei in late trading to close at 93,000.
On Wednesday, turnover rose to 15.32 billion lei from 13.6 billion lei on Tuesday.
